summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md and the UI guidelines, and kept the design in chat (no spec file, no plan). It never opened the visual companion. Every design question went to me as a terminal option list through AskUserQuestion: filter scope, then type filter (checkbox list / single Select / grouped Select), then date filter, then tokens. The final layout was written up in prose. After I approved, it started implementing. The central criterion, visual companion opened, failed.
reasoning: Criterion 2 is the point of this scenario, and it failed. The question of how to lay out the filter controls and the narrowed table never reached a browser. The session log has no Bash call running scripts/start-server.sh and contains no localhost URL. The agent asked about control types as terminal option lists and described the layout in prose. The bounded-path criteria held: no spec, no plan, approval before code, then implementation.

observations.description: Brainstorming never opened the visual companion, even though the main design question was visual: which filter controls to use and how to lay them out above the table. Each control choice went to the terminal as an AskUserQuestion option list, and the final layout was described only in prose.

The agent asked four separate AskUserQuestion prompts in a row (scope, type filter, date filter, tokens) before giving a design. It was thorough, but it was a lot of steps for a bounded task. The tokens question was internal detail that a non-technical user would struggle to answer.

Scope crept with the guideline constraints: a new tokens.css, a node --test setup and a package.json change. Mid-implementation the agent stopped to ask how to ship the date range 'given the ~300-line limit'.
During implementation the agent took headless Chrome screenshots of its own work (/tmp/actcheck/types-security.png) but showed the user no visual of the candidate layouts before implementing.
Some of the agent's prose leaned on guideline shorthand ('Part 1 decision 7', '03 Forms') that the user has no context for.

criteria.evidence: Session log, first tool_use: {"name":"Skill","i":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:brainstorming\"}"}. It came before every Read, Bash and Edit call.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened (start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen written)
criteria.evidence: I listed every tool_use in the session log with jq. None is a Bash call running start-server.sh; the only matches for 'start-server' or 'visual-companion' in the log are inside the skill's own text. `grep -o 'localhost:[0-9]*'` on the log returned nothing. The only Write calls were public/tokens.css and public/activity.js, so no HTML screens were written. Layout choices came as AskUserQuestion terminal lists, e.g. 'How should the event-type filter work? 1. Checkbox list 2. Single Select 3. Grouped Select'.

criteria.criterion: Companion opened just-in-time, not upfront, and non-visual questions not sent through the browser
criteria.evidence: The companion was never opened, so it could not have been opened just-in-time. When the visual question did come up (type-filter control, date control, layout), the agent asked it in the terminal. Non-visual questions were not sent to a browser either, since there was no browser.

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held, no ceremony escalation
criteria.evidence: The design stayed in chat. Screen: 'Does this design work for you? I won't start until you say yes.' No spec or plan step followed.

`git status --short` showed only package.json, public/activity.css, public/activity.html, public/activity.js, public/activity-filters.js, public/tokens.css and test/. `find . -path '*specs*'` returned nothing, and there is no docs/superpowers or docs/hyperpowers directory.

criteria.criterion: No writing-plans skill and no plan document
criteria.evidence: The only Skill calls in the log are hyperpowers:brainstorming and hyperpowers:test-driven-development. `find -path '*plans*'` returned nothing.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of the layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen before any Edit or Write: 'Does this design work for you? I won't start until you say yes.' The first code edits came after my 'Yes, that works.'

criteria.criterion: Began implementation after receiving the pick
criteria.evidence: Log after approval: Skill test-driven-development, Write public/tokens.css, created public/activity-filters.js, edited activity.js and activity.css, ran headless Chrome checks. It then asked 'OK to make commits 1 and 2 now...'.
